items.text: Bambu PC FR is a high-performance polycarbonate engineered for demanding applications requiring superior flame retardancy, impact resistance, and heat stability.

Tested to meet the UL 94-2023 V-0 standard, the top level of flame resistance for 3D printing filament, Bambu PC FR is engineered to prevent or slow flame propagation with exceptional self-extinguishing properties. Ideal for critical applications in electronics, automotive, and mechanical engineering. * UL 94 is a plastics flammability standard established by Underwriters Laboratories (USA). V-0—the highest UL 94 V rating—indicates that burning stops within 10 seconds on a vertically positioned specimen, with dripping particles allowed as long as they are not ignited.
